name: 16014-batchdecode-gptoss120b-1gpu
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b -- 60.8 GiB of top-level safetensors over 15 shards; the repository's 182 GiB total counts the `metal/` and `original/` copies, which are not loaded. Ungated.
parallelism: TP=1, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One GPU, one process, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: GptOssForCausalLM, 36 layers, hidden 2880, 64 attention heads over 8 KV heads with head_dim 64, 128 experts with top-4 routing, MXFP4 expert weights with bf16 activations, 131072 max positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix: prompt tokens ~N(297, 180) truncated to [32, 1024], output tokens ~N(192, 120) truncated to [16, 768], with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on one GPU, serving eight concurrent users short single-turn prompts with mid-length replies.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.6.post2 at commit c8dc4d2d1f1ab32626f43a04accc67917078b22d.
# The launch line is `--model` plus the static memory fraction; every other engine setting is a
# stock default of this commit. host / port / served-model-name are owned by whatever starts
# the server.

model-path: openai/gpt-oss-120b

# The checkpoint occupies 69.4 GB of the card once loaded, more than the default static fraction
# (0.835 of 78.6 GB = 65.6 GB) allows for weights plus KV cache, so at the default the engine
# refuses to start. 0.92 leaves ~2.9 GB of KV cache (~41k tokens at 72 KiB/token, against at most
# 8 x 1.8k in flight) and 6.3 GB outside the static budget, of which the request-to-token table
# takes ~1 GB at the model's 131072-token context: ~5.3 GB for activations and CUDA graphs.
mem-fraction-static: 0.92
